Done — submitted `04-author_bindings-MOD-WLF` with the fix.

- Updated prelude `wlf-hhsize_welfare_pc` to count `hsize` from `silc24_pr` (full person register, all ages) instead of `silc24_p` (15+).
- `welfare`, `welfarenom`, and `welfshprosperity` now use the corrected per-capita denominator.
- Kept `welfaredef`, `welfareother`, `welfareothertype` as `absent` (not collected / not bindable).
